payload.reason: The evidence provides a detailed description of the architecture of the span detector within the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN).

claims.text: The span detector is part of the Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) architecture, which includes a lexicon encoding layer, a contextual layer, and a memory generation layer.
The span detector employs the SAN answer module for its functionality.
The architecture includes various embeddings such as word embeddings, part-of-speech tagging embeddings, and named-entity embeddings for feature mapping.
